issues.jp_before: {いつか|ko-ka}、あの人[ひと]に会[あ]ったことがあります。
issues.problem: いつか with 〜たことがある (past experience) is unnatural; a native would say 前に or どこかで.
issues.action: Deleted; replaced with a future いつか item: いつか、富士山に登りたいです (Someday I want to climb Mount Fuji).

issues.jp_before: {誰[だれ]か|ko-ka}質問[しつもん]はありますか。
issues.problem: Distractor 何か gives 何か質問はありますか, a natural sentence that means the same as 'Does anyone have a question?'.
issues.action: Replaced the 何か distractor with 誰でも and updated why.

issues.jp_before: 今[いま]、{何[なに]も|ko-mo}考[かんが]えられません。
issues.problem: English 'think of anything' (come up with an idea) is 思いつかない; 考えられない is 'think about anything'.
issues.action: English changed to 'I can't think about anything right now.'

issues.jp_before: 質問[しつもん]があれば、{いつでも|ko-demo}聞[き]いてください。
issues.problem: Distractor いつも gives 'if you have questions, always ask me', which is acceptable and close to the English.
issues.action: Replaced いつも with いつか and updated why.

issues.jp_before: 困[こま]ったときは、{いつでも|ko-demo}電話[でんわ]してください。
issues.problem: Distractor いつも gives 困ったときはいつも電話してください, which is natural and nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced いつも with いつか and updated why.

issues.jp_before: 好[す]きな物[もの]を、{どれでも|ko-demo}一[ひと]つ持[も]って帰[かえ]っていいですよ。
issues.problem: Distractor どれか gives どれか一つ持って帰っていい, which is natural and has the same meaning.
issues.action: Rewrote the item as 赤でも青でも、どれでもいいですよ, with distractors どれか / 何か / どこでも.

issues.jp_before: この果物[くだもの]は、{どこでも|ko-demo}売[う]っています。
issues.problem: English 'sold anywhere' is unnatural for this meaning.
issues.action: English changed to 'This fruit is sold everywhere.'
